business: SEGMENT: real estate agents, West Palm Beach
prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in West Palm Beach FL to sell my house?
engine_stated_criteria: near yours and in your price range
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent for every home, but **Meike MacGregor of Coastal Living Group at Compass** is a strong starting point: one current ranking based on reported MLS transaction data places her at the top in West Palm Beach, citing 1,851 transactions and about $1.3 billion in all-time sales. [EffectiveAgents](https://www.effectiveagents.com/fl/west-palm-beach)

For a second opinion, **Sandra Rathe** and **Larry Mastropieri** also rank highly in a seller-focused comparison that considers recent sales, sale-to-list performance, and reviews. [HomeLight](https://www.homelight.com/west-palm-beach-fl/top-real-estate-agents)

Before choosing, interview two or three agents who have recently sold homes **near yours and in your price range**. Ask for a comparative market analysis, their recent listing results, marketing plan, proposed commission, and references from sellers. Rankings are useful leads, but neighborhood and price-point experience matter more than a citywide title.
